crossChecks.claim: This survey's four NON-rationale locations reconcile with the ratified visualArtifacts basis.

locationFinding: 195 of 199 artifacts (98.0%) sit at question.visual. Only 4 live anywhere else. BOTH rationale locations are empty: there is no visual of any kind, pacer or otherwise, in any rationale.visuals slot anywhere in the corpus.

reportByCategory.rawStagingNote: No raw lane exists to flip.
reportByCategory.exportEnvelopeNote: toExportEnvelope infers 1.7 from hasPacerRhythmStrip. All three pacer records sit at question.visual, which the current walker already detects. No inferred envelope version changes under the proposed predicate.
reportByCategory.zeroImpactPopulations: The entire questionRationale and caseQuestionRationale populations are empty (0 of 199). The defect is real in code but unreachable from any current content.

consequenceForP0: The defect is latent, not live. No record currently under-declares its floor.

This makes the retrofit strictly safer to land now than later: the handoff hazard 'do not silently bump canonical metadata to make the test pass' is presently unreachable, because there is no canonical metadata that would need bumping.

Every rationale-location regression case must be SYNTHETIC. There is no corpus record to fixture from, and no committed browser fixture (PROJECT-HISTORY's Visual Focus Dialog entry independently records this same gap).

Corpus proof and synthetic proof are different claims and must be labelled as such: the corpus proves zero flips today; the synthetic fixtures prove the traversal covers every supported location tomorrow.
